notes_for_editor: Sources read: the USCG's NRHP nomination (2017, full text; printed page numbers checked against the page folios, and the 'Beacon' section for the focal plane); LighthouseFriends (facts only, paraphrased); the USLHS place record and roster (cached); the Lighthouse Service Bulletin 1934, p. 170 (PDF p. 4, checked against the page image). Newspaper search (Florida, 1953-1967, Chronicling America) returned nothing; the 1954 Florida Times-Union piece the nomination cites was not read. The USLHS place matched by name only, 38 km from the station record's position, with an 'est. 1954, Mayport' description that fits; its coordinates (30.6433, -81.6633) are wrong for the light and were not used. Its tower material ('Brick') also conflicts with the nomination's reinforced concrete. KEEPERS: the roster and LighthouseFriends are the only sources naming them; no primary record confirms any name. The story names only the two principal keepers, as the archive and LighthouseFriends print them. The nine USCG lines are entered with role 'other' and the note 'USLHS heading: USCG', because the source gives no role word (earlier entries said 'assistant'). The archive's 'at least' spans are kept as printed. DISAGREEMENTS LEFT FOR THE EDITOR: (1) tower height, 49 ft (nomination) vs 64 ft (LighthouseFriends); the record's 19.5 m matches LighthouseFriends; facts use the nomination. (2) Lightship distance: five miles offshore (nomination) vs seven miles (LighthouseFriends). (3) Lightship visibility: 14 miles in clear weather (nomination, the lightship's light) vs 21 miles (the 1934 bulletin's sighting of the St. Johns lightship on 30 Nov 1933). (4) Owner of the 5.2-acre parcel: Coast Guard (nomination) and Coast Guard for the lighthouse (LighthouseFriends) vs U.S. Navy (USLHS place record). (5) Radio-beacon antenna: shortened to 110 ft (p. 21) and demolished on discontinuation (p. 10); no dates. UNITS: the nomination's 19 'miles' for the beacon's visibility does not say nautical miles, so range_nm holds 19 on that unverified basis; the story keeps 'miles'. ACCESSED DATES: footnotes and this record carry 2026-10-27, the date recorded on the research; the fact-check was run on 2026-10-22 as the workflow states, so the accessed dates were not changed. Confidence is medium: the nomination is detailed and consistent, but the keepers are unconfirmed and the station has few recorded events.
